# Copilot instructions – GOW

Single-screen pixel-art platformer modelled on the classic Prince of Persia (1989), set in an original space-knight setting (energy blades, blaster troopers, a red-blade boss). Polish docs in `README.md`.

## Run / test

- No build, no dependencies: open `index.html` directly (works from `file://`).
- Syntax check: `node --check meta.js`, `node --check game.js`, `node --check levels.js`, `node --check ship.js`.
- Headless test from the browser console via `window.GOW` (`loadLevel(i)`, `enterRoom(k)`, `update(dt)`, `K`/`PR` input maps, `P` player, `FOES`, `BOLTS`, `ROOMS`/`ri`/`RD`, `SHIP`). Set `window.requestAnimationFrame = () => {}`, step with `update(GOW.STEP)` and clear `PR` after each step. Load every level and run updates/draws to check for exceptions.

## Architecture

- Scripts load in order `meta.js → levels.js → game.js → ship.js` (plain scripts, shared global scope, no modules).
- `levels.js` – `LEVELS` (35 levels: 6 chapters × 5 platform levels + 5 ship levels). A level has `rooms: [{ map, foes, plats, wl, lore }]` (or top-level `map`/`foes` for level 0); each room is 3 rows × 10 tiles. Tiles `_ # L S W H M A P G D B O C T K E` (`A` = vigor elixir: `potion('A')` adds a temporary bonus heart `P.xhp` (max `XHP_MAX` 3), consumed first by `hurtPlayer`, lost at level end; crates drop it at full HP) (`C` = hidden blade crystal, one per chapter) plus `Q` quicksand, `U` air vent, `N` mine, `I` ice, `J` mushroom launch pad, `F` fire vent (`ventOn`), `V` lava (death), `X` aura block (converted to `_` + entry in room `blocks`/global `BLOCKS`; `moveBlock` slides it, it falls into gaps and becomes a bridge, holds `P` plates via `plateDown`), `Y` lever (`flipLever`, sets global `lever` → gate stays open). Foe kinds: `blaster`, `rifle`, `shield` (`shieldUp` blocks frontal strikes/bolts), `sniper`, `jet` (flying, `updJet`, counts as `isDrone`), `drone`, `lord`. `wl` = water level in px (125 bottom row flooded, -100 whole room). Ship levels have `ship: { diff, from, to, speeder? }` (`speeder: true` = forest speeder-bike chase: `SHIP.sp`, foes `bike`/`tree`, lane `SP_Y0..SP_Y1`, ends after `SHIP.D` s without a boss). Exits are `D`; walking off the screen edge enters the neighbouring room (`roomCheck`). Keep every exit reachable.
- `game.js` – input (keyboard, touch joystick `#stick` + `button[data-k]`, fullscreen `toggleFull`), `fit()` scaling, state (`game`, `P`, `FOES`, `BOLTS`, room globals swapped by `enterRoom`), updates (`updPlayer`, `updTrooper`, `updLord`, drones, `auraPull`/`auraPush` + QTE `game.qte`/`updQte`, swimming `startSwim`/`updO2`, `updPlats`, `updMines`, finishers), drawing (`buildBG` cached in `BGS[lvl:room]` with `THEMES` 0–11, `drawFig` + `STY`, room alarm `raiseAlarm`/`game.al` + tile BFS navigation (`navEdges`/`navStep`/`hunt`/`foeJump`, foe state `fjump` uses `air()`), extra foes `reinforce()` in `mkRoom`, enemy nations `RACE` keyed by foe `sty` (traits read in `updTrooper`/`shoot`/`boltHitsPlayer`), `gait` IK walk/run, `drawWater`, `drawAuraFx`, `lighting`, `drawEmissive`, `drawWin`), WebAudio, fixed 1/60 s loop.
- `meta.js` – meta systems (top level only reads `localStorage`): player profiles `PL` in `gow_players` (`list`, `cur`; `pickPlayer`/`addPlayer`/`delPlayer`/`loadPlayer` switch `SAVE_KEY`/`META_KEY` to `gow_save:<name>`/`gow_meta:<name>` and refill the `META` object in place – never reassign it), run save `gow_save` (written at each `loadLevel` via `saveRun`, only while `game.live`), persistent `META` in `gow_meta` (achievements, owned blades, best), title menu `buildMenu`/`titleKey`, blade collection `XBLADES` + gear screen (mode `gear`, key O), achievements `ACHV`/`achv`/toasts, story pages `STORY`/`showStory` (mode `story`) with light/dark ending (`game.dark`). Original setting only (never Star Wars names): 200 years after Lira Sol, Order of Blade Knights, Republic, Council masters Davan Korr and Oko. `STORY[0]` starts with `{crawl:true}` → perspective opening crawl `CRAWL`/`drawCrawl` (queues `TQ` items with `sy` vertical squash) + `SND.fanfare`. Voices: `VOICE` (Web Speech API, roles nar/ael/lord/hint with pitch/rate, `gow_voice` in localStorage, key V / `#voiceb`); `storySpeak()` on each page, `say()` calls `VOICE.hint` (skips while speaking, no repeats within 6 s).
- `ship.js` – pseudo-3D behind-the-fighter flights with a crystal-upgrade hangar (`startShip`, `updShip`, `drawShip`, `shipHint`, `SHIP`, `SHIP.phase`, `game.shipUp`); `update`/`draw` delegate to it when `LV.ship`.
- `meta.js` also holds stars (`levelStars`, `META.lv`), encyclopedia (`CODEX`, `drawCodex`, mode `codex`), outfits (`OUTFITS`, `heroSty`), NG+ (`ngGame`, `META.ngc`) and boss rush (`rushGame`/`rushNext`, `game.rush`). Collected map crystals per level are kept in `game.got` so they don't respawn after death.
- Controls: A = draw blade + strike (combo 2–5 hits) / pick up / use, S = sheathe, D (hold) = aura dash (`P.dash`: run ×1.9, drains aura instead of regenerating, `jump(130)` while dashing is 35% longer for 10 aura), C = mega jump (`PR.mega` → `jump(vx, true)`, costs `MEGA_COST` 20 aura; normal jump is ~40% shorter: v 62/92, vy −150, air control ±25; mega v 115/170, vy −175, ±40 – higher clips low ceilings; `wideGap()` hint for 3–5 tile gaps; gaps of 4 tiles need mega), Z/X = the two power slots (`game.slots`, max 2 powers; touch buttons get icon `PICON[id]` + label via `updLabels()`; every touch button shows icon + `<small>NAME<b>(KEY)</b></small>` inside the circle, flex column, so lock sequences (`LKEY`) map to buttons), U = skill tree, ↑ in fight = block, ↑+direction in fight = jump with drawn blade, F = fullscreen. Input buffer: ↑/A pressed in `BUSYST` states is stored in `P.bup`/`P.bact` and injected into `PR` once the player reaches a `READYST` state. Foes take 3–5 hits, Lords `5 + lordLv()` (5 on planet 1 … 10). Lord phases (`updLord`) are gated by `f.lv` and relative to `f.max`: first Lord has none (and its room has no other foes); `p1` (lv ≥ 1, hp ≤ 70%) blade throw state `lthrow` → returning bolt `b.lb` (reflect = −2 to its Lord), `fury` (lv ≥ 2, hp ≤ 50%) summons 2 drones, `p3` (lv ≥ 3, hp ≤ 30%) falling rubble `f.rub` (`updRubble`). In `fight` a fresh back-key press flips `P.dir` when `foeBehind(70)` (incl. drones) or the target is > 46 px away; `P.face` timer suppresses auto-facing while a foe is ahead. No blood. Powers work without the blade (except throw). Stealth: a strike on an unaware foe (`!aw`, sleeping or idle with its back turned) kills instantly (`game.cause = 'stealth'`, `game.stealth`). Companion droid `game.bot` (`updBot`, levels ≥ `BOT_LVL`) zaps nearby aware foes and pings `C` crystals.
- Blade lock with Lords (`startLock`/`updLock`/`lockWin`/`lockFail`, state `game.lock`, cooldown `game.lockCd`): triggered by block vs Lord strike, Lord parry, or Lord charge; world runs at 0.15× while the player presses the sequence (`LKEY`: A/↑/Z/X). Sequence is 3–4 keys (4 from lv 2 / fury), window `win` 1.0–1.8 s per key, preceded by a preview `L.pre` 1.3 s („ZWARCIE…” countdown, input ignored, beeps). Powers used (`LNAME`) set the finisher name and effect; damage 2 (+1 with ≥ 2 powers). `lockFail` costs exactly 1 HP (`P.inv` ≥ 1.6, `f.rest` → longer Lord cooldown).
- Audio helpers `tone`, `noise`, `buzz`, `crackle`; persistent blade hum `updHum()`; all sounds synthesized, never copied.
- Skill tree `SKILLS` (3 branches, 12 nodes, 4 levels each, `skl(id)`; `free: true` node `vital` has no prerequisite and adds +1 max HP per level – `hpMax()` = `game.maxHp` (base, saved, big potions) + `skl('vital')`): 10 crystals = 1 point. Powers: pull (QTE, Lord −2 HP), push, shield, trick, heal, throw, choke, bolt. Crystals: drone +1, trooper +2, Lord +10, ship kill bonus.
- Game coordinates 320×200 (`TW=32`, `RH=60`), HUD at y 180–200. The canvas is supersampled (`RS` 2–4); draw smooth shapes, not pixel-snapped rects.
- All text goes through `txt()` (drawn on the full-resolution overlay canvas `#txt`); never `fillText` on the pixel canvas.

## Conventions

- No external assets or dependencies; all art is drawn in code. Do not copy original Prince of Persia assets or use trademarked franchise names (no "Jedi", "Sith", "lightsaber", "Force" – the power is called "aura").
- After changing any script, bump `?v=N` on all `<script>` tags in `index.html` (same number).
- Comments, UI text and docs in Polish. Files UTF-8 without BOM, LF.
- Keep `README.md` (controls, levels, rules) in sync with code.
